title: An Empirical Study on CVE-based Vulnerabilities Propagation from one System to another System (IntraProject vs InterProject)
abstract: arXiv:2611.14164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vulnerabilities in applications, including browsers, media players, online services and document readers, etc. are often exploited and cause a serious damage. The vulnerabilities could exist in your system maybe because of some coding errors, design oversights, outdated software, AI generated codes or maybe transferred from another system during development (e.g., code clones). The propagation of software vulnerabilities is a critical concern in cybersecurity. This study examines the root cause problem of vulnerabilities propagation with experiments. We analyzed the propagation of CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) based vulnerabilities within and between different software projects (IntraProject vs. InterProject). We performed several experiments on CVE based vulnerability dataset (retrieved from NVD source) by using our vulnerability detection tool (SQVDT). translated_title: 基于CVE的漏洞从一个系统传播到另一个系统的实证研究（项目内 vs 项目间）
translated_abstract: 应用程序中的漏洞（包括浏览器、媒体播放器、在线服务和文档阅读器等）经常被利用并造成严重损害。这些漏洞存在于系统中的原因可能是编码错误、设计疏忽、软件过时、AI生成的代码，或者在开发过程中从另一个系统传播而来（例如代码克隆）。软件漏洞的传播是网络安全领域的一个关键问题。本研究通过实验考察漏洞传播的根本原因问题，分析了基于CVE（常见漏洞与披露）的漏洞在不同软件项目内部和项目之间的传播情况（项目内 vs 项目间）。我们使用自研的漏洞检测工具（SQVDT）对从NVD来源获取的基于CVE的漏洞数据集进行了多项实验。在实验结果中，我们发现了脆弱代码的相似模式……
tldr: 本研究通过实验分析了基于CVE的漏洞在软件项目内部与项目之间的传播规律，并利用自研漏洞检测工具SQVDT发现了脆弱代码传播的相似模式。
en_tdlr: This study empirically investigates the propagation of CVE-based vulnerabilities within and across software projects (IntraProject vs. InterProject) using their vulnerability detection tool SQVDT, revealing similar patterns of vulnerable code propagation.
